Process.title: Strategy
Process.description: Analyze the client's business problem and objectives. Identify relevant data success for the AI model. Define measurement metrics and create a client-centric roadmap.

Process.title: Design
Process.description: To design the AI solution, we select algorithms and models, define data architecture and infrastructure, design the user interface and user experience, and create a proof of concept or prototype.

Process.title: Build
Process.description: After the design, the AI solution is built by collecting and cleaning data, training and tuning models, integrating and testing system components, and deploying to production.

Process.title: Optimize
Process.description: The AI solution is continually refined to improve its performance by monitoring its metrics, refining the algorithms and models, updating the data sources and infrastructure, and integrating feedback from users.
